comments.text: The request said 'add as embedded a forge entity'. The live system.integration.Forge is persistable (its own table, stored credentials), so it cannot itself be embedded; ForgeLink is an owned child that references it instead. If the intent was to copy forge details inline onto the entity, that would duplicate credential-bearing configs — confirm or reshape.

text: forgeLink | embedded(ForgeLink) | no | the entity's forge association — one, edited inline on its form

comments.text: Resolved the earlier list-vs-single question per the author: the field is now single-valued (embedded(ForgeLink)), so an entity carries at most one forge association.
